policy.authority: PTO ASL, accepted architecture decisions, and this contract catalog define the portable numeric boundary; backend behavior is evidence only.
policy.support_boundary: An implementation may reject an operation/type tuple, but it may not silently change the portable result of an accepted tuple.
policy.bounded_variation: A portable rule may delegate a result dimension only to a visible numeric mode with a finite or mathematically testable allowed-result contract.
policy.unknown_selection: Unknown identities, modes, formats, operation/type tuples, and missing delegated rules reject before architectural effects.
policy.cpu_observation: CPU observations are implementation-under-test diagnostics and are never an architectural contract or independent oracle.

identities.role: Portable result, legality, and pre-effect rejection contract for accepted numeric operation/type tuples.
identities.selection: Applies to every PTO numeric operation; implementations may only narrow support or implement an explicitly delegated bounded variation point.
identities.relation_to_portable_contract: Supplies the portable result, legality, and pre-effect rejection contract for accepted numeric operation/type tuples.

identities.role: Versioned implementation-under-test observations and developer diagnostics.
identities.selection: Cannot be selected as an architectural numeric profile or independent conformance oracle.
identities.relation_to_portable_contract: Only observes implementations; it defines neither portable results nor a target contract.
